problem.label: The Problem
problem.description: Late entries and price-only indicators hide what is actually moving the market.

cards.title: Late entries
cards.text: The chart shows the move after it happens. You enter when institutional players may already be leaving.

cards.title: Frequent stop-outs
cards.text: Without order flow context, separating noise from institutional movement becomes harder.

cards.title: Lagging indicators
cards.text: Moving averages, RSI and MACD use past price and do not show who is executing now.

cards.title: Hidden absorption
cards.text: Large participants can absorb aggressive orders before moving price.

problem.quote: Price moves because someone is executing large orders. Learning to read flow creates a clearer view of that movement.
problem.quoteBy: Gustavo Guimarães, creator of LGVG Flow

solution.label: The Solution
solution.description: Built for the B3 mini index after extensive operational testing and validation.

cards.title: Aggression Reading
cards.text: Analyzes executed buying and selling pressure in real time.

cards.title: Absorption Detection
cards.text: Helps identify when large participants absorb aggressive orders to build positions.

cards.title: Institutional Flow View
cards.text: Organizes the behavior behind price before it becomes evident on the chart.

cards.title: Clearer Timing
cards.text: Supports the reading of entries, continuation and exhaustion.

developer.label: Authority and Experience
developer.name: Gustavo Guimarães
developer.photoAlt: Professional portrait of Gustavo Guimarães, creator of LGVG Flow
paragraphs: Creator of LGVG Flow, Gustavo Guimarães is an entrepreneur, Computer Scientist and specialist in developing technology solutions for companies and the financial market.
Founder of UAI Software and consultant to Grupo Cybersul, he has experience developing management software, web platforms, corporate dashboards and vehicle tracking systems.

He specializes in Telecommunications Engineering and Information Technology, has complementary studies in Law and a specialization in Web 3.0 (Blockchain, Smart Contracts and the Metaverse) from Brazil's Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation (MCTI).
He is also the author of a technical work on GSM approved by the Instituto Superior de Engenharia de Lisboa (ISEL), in partnership with the University of Franca.

This experience in technology, systems analysis and software development was applied to the creation of LGVG Flow, an indicator designed to help traders read order flow, liquidity and operational context in B3 Mini Index trading.
credentials: Author of a technical work approved by ISEL (Portugal)
